name: OCRRouter
author: OCRRouter
description: OCR for agents: PDFs and images to Markdown or JSON, routed across OCR models. Jina OCR and DeepSeek-OCR are free, 50,000 pages a month.

tools.name: ocr
tools.description: Read a PDF or image and return its text as Markdown (tables kept as tables) or JSON blocks. Pass file_url for a public link, or file_base64 for file contents. Models jina/jina-ocr and deepseek/deepseek-ocr are free; auto picks the best model for the document.

file_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a PDF, PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF.

file_base64.description: Base64 file contents, instead of file_url.

filename.description: File name with extension, recommended with file_base64.

model.description: Model ID from list_models, or auto (default).

pages.description: Page range such as 1-5,8. Default all pages.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the OCR models you can route to, with credits per page (0 = free) and whether each is available.
